description: This file defines classes and methods for querying, fetching, and processing economic indicator data from EconDB, including parameter validation, data extraction, transformation, and handling of API responses.

classes.name: EconDbEconomicIndicatorsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for EconDB economic indicators, including validation for countries and symbols.

classes.name: EconDbEconomicIndicatorsData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for economic indicators fetched from EconDB.

classes.name: EconDbEconomicIndicatorsFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching, transforming, and processing economic indicator data from EconDB API.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms and validates query parameters, setting default date ranges and validating countries and symbols.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from EconDB API based on query parameters, handling API response pagination and caching.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into structured, validated data objects, normalizing units and handling metadata.
